mapper.select: select p.name as personName, (select d.dept_name from sys_dept d where d.dept_id = p.dept_id) as personDept from jc_person p where p.person_id = #{personId} and p.del_flag = '0'

select clue_no as source_no, summary as summary, status as source_status from jc_clue where person_id = #{personId} and del_flag = '0' and status in ('0','1','2','3') and is_duplicate = '0' order by create_time desc

select concat('petition:', p.petition_id) as source_no, p.title as summary, p.status as source_status from jc_petition p where p.target_name = (select name from jc_person where person_id = #{personId} and del_flag = '0') and p.del_flag = '0' and p.status not in ('6','7') order by p.create_time desc

select issue_no as source_no, title as summary, status as source_status from jc_rectify_issue where target_person_id = #{personId} and del_flag = '0' and status in ('0','1','2') order by create_time desc

select alert_no as source_no, rule_name as summary, status as source_status, alert_level as alert_level, score as score from jc_risk_alert where object_type = '0' and object_id = #{personId} and del_flag = '0' and status in ('0','1') order by score desc, create_time desc

select concat('SUP:', s.supplier_code) as source_no, concat('与供应商「', s.supplier_name, '」存在', l.link_type, '关联') as summary, l.handle_result as source_status from jc_supplier_link l left join jc_supplier s on s.supplier_id = l.supplier_id where l.person_id = #{personId} and l.del_flag = '0' and l.handle_result in ('0','2','3') order by l.create_time desc

select concat('处分:', punish_id) as source_no, concat(punish_type, '：', punish_reason) as summary, date_format(punish_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as source_status from jc_person_punish where person_id = #{personId} and del_flag = '0' and punish_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 3 year) order by punish_date desc

select p.person_id as personId, p.person_code as personCode, p.name as personName, d.dept_name as personDept from jc_person p left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id where p.del_flag = '0'
and (p.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.person_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by p.person_code limit 20
